state: Goal `core-time-datetime`: `Core\Time\DateTime::date`, `::dayOfYear`, `::difference` and `::toInstant` have every feature proof on disk except their perf figure, which the driver's sweep records (it reads `perf: stale` for all four until then, because `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs` moved). `Core\Time\DateTime` has its class card, so no member owes `help`. `difference`'s attack found that a `Month` or `Quarter` count across the whole calendar threw; it is fixed (the member sums years and months when jiff's month span is too short) and pinned in `tests/conformance/core/time-datetime-parts-agree-with-the-value-they-came-from.nvst`. The Rust tests for all four sit at the end of the `time.rs` test module: `datetime_built(&Zoned)` builds a receiver, `nvs_runtime::call` drives the member, and `datetime_difference` shows how to read a thrown sentence. Nothing is blocked.
